hero.headline: Explore Africa.
hero.intro: Safaris, coastlines, culture and open country, planned with specialists who know the ground — and arranged around how you actually want to travel.

cta.title: Tell us when you can travel, and we will tell you what is possible.
cta.body: An enquiry costs nothing and commits you to nothing. Send your dates and a rough idea of the trip, and a specialist will reply with questions and an outline.
cta.note: Enquiries are never treated as confirmed bookings.
